newsitem.title: JAPAN: Idemitsu raises Feb oil product wholesale prices.
newsitem.headline: Idemitsu raises Feb oil product wholesale prices.

text.p: Major refiner Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd said on Thursday it would raise wholesale prices of its oil products by 1,200 yen per kilolitre (kl), effective February 1.
Following the hike, gasoline will be priced at 92,500 yen per kl. Kerosene and gas oil, neither of which is taxed at the wholesale stage, will be priced at 38,500 yen per kl.
The rise reflects a weaker yen against the dollar during May compared with April, as well as higher crude oil prices.

Major Japanese oil companies have been reviewing their wholesale product prices on a monthly basis, taking into account international prices of crude and oil products as well as currency market fluctuations.
